newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai shares plunge 4.98 percent as trade resumes.
newsitem.headline: Thai shares plunge 4.98 percent as trade resumes.

text.p: Thai shares tumbled as foreign investors sold out in all key sectors as trading, which was halted for almost the whole day, resumed for a 30 minute period late on Monday afternoon, traders said.
After a near day long delay in trading blamed on a computer problem, Thai stocks finally resumed trading at 0915 GMT. The market is due to close at 0945 GMT.
The index immediately sank at opening losing 28.92 points, or 4.98 percent, to 552.21. The SET 50 fell 2.90 points to 39.59.
